sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(uid AS TEXT)) AS n_users FROM impressions) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN conversion = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_converting_displays FROM impressions) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_journeys FROM conversion_flags WHERE touch_count = 2) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT SUM(click) AS n_clicks FROM impressions) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT recency_bucket, COUNT(*) AS n_last_touches FROM journeys_converting WHERE is_last = 1 GROUP BY recency_bucket ORDER BY n_last_touches ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(attribution AS DOUBLE)) AS share_advertiser_credited FROM journeys_converting) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(unit AS TEXT) AS unit, impression_share FROM segment_economics WHERE period = 'days_16_30' ORDER BY impression_share DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(share AS DOUBLE)) AS share_four_or_more_touches FROM journey_length_distribution WHERE touch_count >= 4) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN conversion = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_later_convert FROM impressions WHERE click = 1) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_segments FROM v_segment_cpa_default WHERE period = 'full' AND cpa > 1 AND unit <> 'other') AS _q LIMIT 1000

SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(r.unit AS TEXT) AS unit, v.cpa FROM reallocation_plan AS r JOIN v_segment_cpa_default AS v ON r.unit = v.unit WHERE v.period = 'full' AND r.role = 'receiver') AS _q LIMIT 1000

SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(u.unit AS TEXT) AS unit, SUM(u.linear_credit) / SUM(SUM(u.linear_credit)) OVER () AS share_even_split_credit FROM v_linear_last_by_unit AS u JOIN journeys_converting AS j ON u.unit = j.unit WHERE j.touch_count = 2 GROUP BY u.unit HAVING u.unit = 'other') AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(unit AS TEXT) AS unit, SUM(last_credit) AS total_last_click_credit FROM v_linear_last_by_unit WHERE unit <> 'other' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_last_click_credit DESC LIMIT 1
REFUSE

SELECT CAST(v_view_click_spend.unit AS TEXT) AS unit, spend_share / v_segment_cpa_default.cpa AS roas FROM v_view_click_spend JOIN v_segment_cpa_default ON v_view_click_spend.unit = v_segment_cpa_default.unit WHERE v_segment_cpa_default.period = 'full' AND v_view_click_spend.unit = 'Facebook Reels' LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(uid AS TEXT)) AS n_users FROM impressions) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN conversion = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS share_converting_displays FROM impressions) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_journeys FROM conversion_flags WHERE touch_count = 2) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT SUM(click) AS n_clicks FROM impressions) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT recency_bucket, COUNT(*) AS n_last_touches FROM journeys_converting WHERE is_last = 1 GROUP BY recency_bucket ORDER BY n_last_touches ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT share_advertiser_credited AS share_credited FROM advertiser_gap_overall) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(unit AS TEXT) AS unit, impression_share FROM segment_economics WHERE period = 'days_16_30' ORDER BY impression_share DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(is_advertiser_credited AS DOUBLE)) AS share_four_or_more_touches FROM conversion_flags WHERE touch_count >= 4) AS _q LIMIT 1000

SELECT * FROM (SELECT AVG(CAST(conversion_flags.is_advertiser_credited AS DOUBLE)) AS share_later_convert FROM impressions JOIN conversion_flags ON impressions.conversion_id = conversion_flags.conversion_id WHERE impressions.click = 1) AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_segments FROM v_segment_cpa_default WHERE period = 'full' AND cpa > 1) AS _q LIMIT 1000

SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(c.unit AS TEXT) AS unit, c.cpa FROM v_segment_cpa_default AS c JOIN reallocation_plan AS r ON c.unit = r.unit WHERE r.role = 'receiver' AND c.period = 'full') AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(unit AS TEXT) AS unit, last_credit / SUM(last_credit) OVER () AS share_even_split_credit FROM v_linear_last_by_unit WHERE unit = 'other') AS _q LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(unit AS TEXT) AS unit, SUM(last_credit) AS total_last_click_credit FROM v_linear_last_by_unit WHERE unit <> 'other' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_last_click_credit DESC LIMIT 1
REFUSE
SELECT * FROM (SELECT CAST(unit AS TEXT) AS unit, cpa FROM v_segment_cpa_default WHERE period = 'full' AND unit = 'Facebook Reels') AS _q LIMIT 1000
